Messages.Author: Ben Peal
Messages.Body:
If a minion with Lunatic Eruption played on it has no legal targets,
is it forced to do nothing that turn, or is it free to act as it
wishes?

I've ruled in the past that the minion is free to do as it wishes.
As much as the cases of Lunatic Eruption and hunting are similar,
the rules for compulsory hunting are specific to hunting and not a
generalized rule, and Lunatic Eruption makes no statement about
being unable to act if the attack action cannot be performed.

However, this doesn't sit right with me and my players (and my players
keep bugging me about it), so I figured I'd ask.

- Ben Peal, Prince of Boston
fu...@mindstorm.com

chair...therefore do nothing.

Let this be a lesson to everyone, thoroughly go over your pay stub and
verify that your employer is taking out enough taxes.
